settings.aboutBody1: It is a reflective parenting companion that offers warm, science-informed guidance for everyday moments with your child.
settings.aboutBody2: The app does not diagnose, treat, or replace care from a qualified professional. If you are worried about your child's safety, development, or mental health — or your own — please speak with a pediatrician, therapist, or other licensed practitioner. In an emergency, contact your local emergency services.

aiConsent.title: Sharing your story with AI
aiConsent.body1: To give you guidance, Kidsit AI sends the following to our server, and from there to OpenAI:
aiConsent.bullet1: Audio you record, transcribed to text by OpenAI Whisper.
aiConsent.bullet2: The story text, the context you pick (location, your mood, who else was there, and how urgent it feels), the full child profile (name, birthdate, gender, intake answers, and notes), siblings (name, age, birthdate, and gender), and saved history for every child (stories, AI responses, ratings, and notes).
aiConsent.body2: OpenAI (Whisper and GPT-4o-mini) processes this under OpenAI's API data policy. It is not used to train models. Profiles and history are also kept on this device.
aiConsent.body3: By tapping Agree below, you consent to this processing. You can revoke this at any time in Settings.
aiConsent.agree: I agree — start using Kidsit AI
aiConsent.declinedNote: You can enable AI guidance any time in Settings → Privacy.
aiConsent.settingsHintEnabled: The story, full child profile, siblings, history, and a RevenueCat ID are sent when you ask for guidance.
aiConsent.settingsHintDisabled: AI guidance disabled. Tap to enable.
aiConsent.bullet3: Your RevenueCat ID in the X-RC-User header, so the server can check the subscription. That header is not part of the text sent to OpenAI, and it is never sent with anonymous insights.

insights.previewIntro: Anonymous. No name, no id, no story. The week is an ISO week, not a date.
insights.ratingLabel: How much did Kidsit help this week?
insights.textWarning: Don't write names, places, contact details, or medical details. You will see the scrubbed text before it is sent. Free text is deleted after 90 days.
insights.scrubbedLabel: Scrubbed text that will be sent
insights.leftOut: Moments without a category stay on this device and are not in this send.
insights.sentBody: Sent without a name or an identifier. Because this is anonymous, a specific submission can't be deleted. Free text is deleted automatically after 90 days.
insights.error: Couldn't send. Nothing was retried. You can try again.
insights.alreadySent: Already sent this week, without a name or an identifier.
insights.explainBody: This stays off until you turn it on. You can turn it off anytime. It does not change the app or the price. Each send still asks you to confirm.
insights.explainSent: What a send can include: counts by situation type from a fixed list, an optional 1–5 rating, and optional free text scrubbed of names, emails, phones, ID numbers, and links. Also the language, platform, app version, and the ISO week. Free text is deleted after 90 days.
insights.explainNot: What is never included: names, stories, the AI's replies, age, gender, notes, or any id, including the RevenueCat header.
insights.nudgeBody: One ask. Counts only, unless you add a rating or a note. You can say no and we won't ask again.
